system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Use `{{KEY}}` placeholders in your prompt to inject values from the `promptArgs` option.
system_prompt_style.note: Sandcastle renders the user prompt file (promptArgs, built-in SOURCE_BRANCH/TARGET_BRANCH, !`command` expansion); the system prompt itself is owned by the wrapped agent CLI (Claude Code etc.). Could be read as dynamically_composed given shell expansion.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: no opinions about workflow, task management, or context sources are imposed.
env_context_strategy.note: Navigation is done by the wrapped agent CLI; optional !`command` context injection in prompt files is user-authored.

context_compaction.note: Context management is delegated to wrapped agent CLIs; evidence contains no Sandcastle-level history config surface for compaction.

observation_format.note: Tool observations are handled inside the wrapped agent CLI; not visible in evidence.

tool_call_format.note: Tool-call syntax belongs to the wrapped agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.); Sandcastle only parses stdout stream.

tool_count.note: Tools are those of the wrapped agent CLI; no tool registry in Sandcastle evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tools belong to the wrapped agent CLI.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema generation in Sandcastle evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: README mentions MCP servers spawned by the agent, but only as child processes of wrapped CLIs; no Sandcastle protocol client in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Maximum number of agent iterations to run before stopping. Default: 1
loop_primitives.note: Outer iteration loop over agent CLI invocations (default 1). Templates ship pipelines (plan/implement/review/merge); fork enables fan-out. Inner react loop is in the wrapped agent. Closest values.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Plans parallelizable issues, executes on separate branches, then merges
planning_granularity.note: Default blank template has no plan; parallel-planner template emits a <plan> structured output (explicit plan object reachable via template).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: You invoke agents with a single `sandcastle.run()`.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: You invoke agents with a single `sandcastle.run()`.
delegation_mechanism.note: Orchestration is user script-driven; templates hand off between runs (role_handoff-like).

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When set, replaces Sandcastle's default `--dangerously-skip-permissions` on AFK runs.
human_in_loop.note: AFK runs skip permissions by default; interactive() allows a human-driven TUI session; permissionMode can be set.

short_term_state.note: State managed by wrapped agent sessions.

long_term_memory.note: No memory config in evidence; delegated to agent CLIs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Pass `resumeSession` to `run()` to continue a prior Claude Code, Codex, or Pi conversation inside a new sandbox

self_verification.evidence_quote: You write the prompt, and the engine executes it — no opinions about workflow, task management, or context sources are imposed.
self_verification.note: Review steps exist only in templates (sequential-reviewer); structured-output schema validation exists. Tests via sandbox.exec are user-scripted.

retry_policy.note: Opt-in fixed_n retries for structured output via maxRetries.

rollback.evidence_quote: The agent works on a throwaway branch; if something goes wrong, HEAD is untouched.
rollback.note: Default for docker is head strategy (no worktree); merge-to-head/branch strategies config-reachable.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: String (or array of strings) the agent emits to end the iteration loop early.
termination_condition.note: maxIterations caps iterations (default 1); idle timeout also ends run with error.

cost_controls.note: Only usage reporting shown; cost controls delegated to agent CLIs.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Idle timeout in seconds — resets whenever the agent produces output. Default: 600 (10 minutes)
timeouts.note: Idle timeout plus per-lifecycle-step and per-hook timeouts; no total run wall-clock cap. Closest value.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Sandcastle uses a `SandboxProvider` to create isolated environments.
execution_isolation.note: sandbox is required; docker/podman containers typical, Vercel Firecracker microVM, noSandbox host available.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: the worktree directory is bind-mounted into the container
filesystem_access.note: Relative to container: repo mounted plus optional mounts.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Optional: attach container to Docker network(s) — string or string[]
network_policy.note: Network selector only; no egress restriction.

permission_model.evidence_quote: When set, replaces Sandcastle's default `--dangerously-skip-permissions` on AFK runs.

tracing.evidence_quote: Capture agent session JSONL to host for `claude --resume`

replayability.evidence_quote: Fork the captured session for one iteration inside the same warm sandbox.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: no opinions about workflow, task management, or context sources are imposed.
eval_hooks.note: File tree shows no benchmark runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: When set, replaces Sandcastle's default `--dangerously-skip-permissions` on AFK runs.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A TypeScript library for orchestrating AI coding agents in isolated sandboxes

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Orchestrate sandboxed coding agents in TypeScript with sandcastle.run()
